claim: Literature comparison; no new theorem. Livingston 1995 (Lemma 7, Theorems 8-9, Corollary 10) already contains the topological content of CLOSED-H1-20261025-001B, and the 2013 equal-count conjecture for C[6,1], C[6,2] follows from its Theorem 9; Ishikawa 2025 was not accessible in full; CLOSED-H1-20261025-001C is not in the sources read and rests on BOUNDED-H1-20261025-001A.
conclusion: CLOSED-H1-20261025-001B is a rediscovery of Livingston 1995 (with Edmonds-Livingston 1984, Thistlethwaite 1985, Rickard 1984); the 2009 and 2013 quandle conjectures were settled implicitly by that work; the closed-manifold hardness is unaffected but rests on the knot hardness; Ishikawa 2025 full text not accessed.
